title: USB002: every show
source: Fred again.. pinned comment on the video

entries.title: GLASGOW
entries.memory: With Rick Salad, HAAi, ¥ØU$UK€ ¥UK1MAT$U, and Blanco.

entries.title: BRUSSELS
entries.memory: Opening by DC Noises b2b SHOPLIFTER, then KŌMA b2b LAURAVIOLI before Fred closed.

entries.title: MADRID
entries.memory: With DREA opening, Skin On Skin, and Toccororo on the bill.

entries.title: LYON
entries.memory: With Floating Points and Caribou — the three of them closed it together.

entries.title: DUBLIN
entries.memory: With Caolan Ryan, EMA, FDC DJs, Shady Nasty, Travy + Elzzz, Reggie, and Amyl.

entries.title: TORONTO 1
entries.memory: With Brat Star, FROSSYOUTH, and Loukeman on support.

entries.title: TORONTO 2
entries.memory: Fred again.. b2b Four Tet — the two of them, the whole night.

entries.title: CHICAGO
entries.memory: With Sammy Virji, back and forth across the night.

entries.title: VANCOUVER
entries.memory: With Lou Nour opening, then Skream & Benga joining Fred on the decks.

entries.title: SAN FRAN
entries.memory: Bad juuju, Clearcast, and Vertigo opened; Oppidan and Hamdi joined Fred to close.

entries.title: NY1
entries.memory: With Romy and HAAi — the three of them traded sets and closed together.

entries.title: NY2
entries.memory: BRUX opened; Oppidan, Hamdi, and Romy all played before Fred closed.

entries.title: NY3
entries.memory: X3butterfly, Doctor Jeep, and Sister Zo opened; Denzel Curry and 070 Shake also on the bill.

entries.title: NY4
entries.memory: BRUX opened; Fred back and forth with Caribou, Denzel Curry and 070 Shake between.

entries.title: NY5
entries.memory: BRUX opened, Danny Brown played mid-set before Fred closed.

entries.title: NY6
entries.memory: With Ben UFO and Caribou — plus Danny Brown live between the DJ sets.

entries.title: LDN 1
entries.memory: Hamdi and Oppidan opened; Berwyn, Nia Archives, Blanco, Jamie T, Headie One, and Ezra Collective all came through.

entries.title: LDN 2
entries.memory: MPH, JOY (Anonymous), and Femi opened with Fred; Blanco, Berwyn, Romy, JME & D Double E, The Streets, and Underworld all took the stage.

entries.title: LDN 3
entries.memory: Lou Nour b2b Fred to open; Skream, Benga, Coki, and Mala joined in, then Durrty Goodz, D Double E, Flowdan & JME, Blanco, Berwyn, Ezra Collective, and La Roux.

entries.title: LDN 4
entries.memory: The finale: The Streets, Berwyn, Ezra Collective, Kano, and Jamie T all played before Fred closed the whole tour with Thomas Bangalter.
